found_in_own_draft.what: The first guide build produced 14 pages and 8,218 gate words, far below the 30-page promise carried by the product and its cover.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: extracting the built PDF and counting pages with pypdf and words with the gate's own tokenizer before packaging
found_in_own_draft.fix: Added a second substantive paragraph to each of the 30 sections and a page break per section; the rebuilt guide is 30 pages and 10,378 gate words, with every page carrying at least 300 words.

found_in_own_draft.what: The workbook builder contained a Python syntax error in a date literal (2026-11-05 written with a leading zero), so the workbook could not be rebuilt.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: running the builder and reading the traceback
found_in_own_draft.fix: Corrected the literal to date(2026, 11, 5) and rebuilt the workbook from source.

found_in_own_draft.what: Four Summary ranges were offset by two rows (+3 instead of +1), so formulas counted blank rows and would have missed real medication, appointment, insurance, and decision entries.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: reading every Summary range against each sheet's actual header row and first data row
found_in_own_draft.fix: Changed every affected range to start at row 2 and end at the intended last data row; the native Excel probe and the independent model now agree.

found_in_own_draft.what: Data validation and filter ranges covered header rows or stopped short of the last data row.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: comparing each validation sqref with its sheet's data block
found_in_own_draft.fix: Set every validation and filter to the data rows only (for example Medications I2:I31, Appointments J2:J26, Daily Log F2:F32).

found_in_own_draft.what: The Expenses & Mileage builder wrote a title into row 1 and then used row 1 as the header, so the mileage-rate cell and the header row overwrote each other and the mileage formulas referenced the wrong row.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: opening the first rebuilt workbook and seeing formulae with no header above them
found_in_own_draft.fix: Rebuilt the sheet with the rate in B1, headers in row 2, data rows 3-32, and the formula =IF(F3="","",F3*$B$1) copied down.

found_in_own_draft.what: The Emergency One-Pager date-of-birth cell had no date number format, so a real date would display as a serial number.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: reading cell B5's number format after the first build
found_in_own_draft.fix: Applied the yyyy-mm-dd format to B5.

found_in_own_draft.what: The example deed review date was old enough to trigger the 'documents not reviewed in 12 months' warning on the day of delivery, making a clean example look defective.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: running the native recalculation and reading Summary!B26
found_in_own_draft.fix: Changed the example deed review date to 2026-04-15 so the example file passes its own integrity checks while still demonstrating the review date field.

found_in_own_draft.what: The first listing title was 68 characters, so the quality gate's title-specificity check scored it false and the core layer lost 15 points.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: running the real gate against the draft product record
found_in_own_draft.fix: Shortened the listing title to 57 characters while keeping emergency, medication, and appointments explicit; the rebuilt gate result is APPROVED with no failed checks.

found_in_own_draft.what: The first cover set the subtitle at 30px, which crowded the right-hand handoff card.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: rendering the cover and inspecting the text bounds against the card edge
found_in_own_draft.fix: Reduced the subtitle to 27px and re-rendered the cover at 1280x720.

found_in_own_draft.what: The guide inspection failed because the PDF line-wrapped the exact sheet name Respite & Backup across two lines, even though both words were present.
found_in_own_draft.found_by: running the guide inspection after the 30-page rebuild and reading the missing-sheet list
found_in_own_draft.fix: Moved Respite & Backup to the start of its own appendix paragraph so the exact name stays on one extracted line; the rebuilt guide passes with all fourteen sheet names found.
